use_cases.name: Hold concurrent assignments for one person
use_cases.goal: Let one person hold more than one concurrent assignment in a different entity, position or worker class, each with its own pay, time and security treatment.

stakeholders.interest: Is paid correctly for each role and sees each assignment separately in self-service.
Each assignment lands in the right payroll group with no double counting of statutory ceilings.
Statutory identifiers such as UAN stay unique to the person across assignments.

use_cases.trigger: HR needs a person already employed in one entity to take an additional concurrent role, for example a quality engineer at Peenya Works also serving as part-time trainer for LE-02.
preconditions: The person exists once with a primary assignment (RL-032).
A vacant, non-frozen position exists for the additional assignment (RL-034).
Concurrent employment is enabled for the tenant and the combination of worker classes is permitted.
postconditions_success: The person holds two active assignments with distinct payroll group, shift group, worker class defaults and approver chains; one is marked primary.
postconditions_failure: No second assignment is created and the person's existing assignment is unchanged.

main_flow.action: Searches for the person and opens the record of E1069 Meera Prabhu.
Chooses to add a concurrent assignment and selects entity LE-02, position and worker class.
Checks that the position is vacant and that the worker-class combination is allowed for concurrent employment.
Applies worker-class defaults for the new assignment and shows fields HR may override with a reason.
Sets effective date, working-hours share, pay basis and which assignment is primary.
Routes the change through the approval chain for both entities.
Approves the additional assignment.
Writes the new assignment version, links it to the same person and payroll groups, and queues attendance recompute.
Notifies payroll of both groups that statutory ceilings must be shared across assignments.

alternate_flows.condition: The additional role is within the same entity.
steps: The platform keeps one payroll group and splits cost centres by working-hours share.
The rejection reason is recorded and HR is notified; no assignment is written.

exception_flows.condition: The target position is filled or frozen.
exception_flows.handling: The assignment cannot be created and the position status is shown.

exception_flows.condition: The two assignments' scheduled hours overlap on the same day.
exception_flows.handling: The platform warns HR and requires a shift arrangement before activation.

exception_flows.condition: A user in one payroll group opens the record.
exception_flows.handling: Compensation fields of the other assignment return null.

nfrs: A person record with up to five concurrent assignments opens in under 1.5 s.
Statutory identifiers remain unique per person regardless of assignment count.

user_stories.want: to add a second concurrent assignment to an existing person
user_stories.so_that: I don't create a duplicate person for a second role

acceptance.given: E1069 holds a permanent assignment at LOC-PLA
acceptance.when: I add a trainer assignment in LE-02 at LOC-HYD effective 2026-11-01
acceptance.then: E1069 shows two active assignments and one person identifier

acceptance.given: the selected position is frozen
acceptance.when: I try to add the assignment
acceptance.then: creation is blocked with the frozen status named

user_stories.want: each assignment paid in its own payroll group
user_stories.so_that: pay and statutory contributions are processed by the right entity

acceptance.given: E1069 has assignments in PLANT-BLR and PLANT-HYD
acceptance.then: E1069 appears in both run populations with the assignment identifier on each payslip

acceptance.given: the PF wage ceiling applies to the person
acceptance.then: the payroll exception list shows the shared-ceiling check for E1069

user_stories.want: to see each of my assignments separately in self-service
user_stories.so_that: I can track pay and attendance for each role

acceptance.given: I hold two assignments
acceptance.when: I open my payslips for November 2026
acceptance.then: I see one payslip per assignment, each labelled with its entity

acceptance.given: I apply for leave
acceptance.then: the request routes to that assignment's manager only

use_cases.name: Plan headcount and positions against sanctioned strength
use_cases.goal: Allow HR and finance to plan positions and headcount by period, site and cost centre against sanctioned strength, with approval and variance tracking.

stakeholders.interest: Headcount growth stays within an approved plan and budget.
Planned cost per cost centre is visible before positions are opened.
Can request the people needed for production volumes.

use_cases.trigger: The annual operating plan cycle opens, or a manager proposes a mid-year change to the plan.
preconditions: Sanctioned strength is recorded by org unit, designation and location with effective dates (RL-055).
Filled and open counts are derived from assignments and requisitions (RL-056).
Average cost per designation band is available for planning.
postconditions_success: An approved headcount plan exists per period, site and cost centre; approved additions update sanctioned strength from their effective dates.
postconditions_failure: The plan stays in draft and sanctioned strength is unchanged.

main_flow.action: Opens a headcount plan for FY 2027-28 and seeds it with current sanctioned, filled and open counts.
Proposes changes per quarter, for example +6 machinists for Chakan Works Machining from Q2.
Computes planned headcount, headroom and planned cost per site and cost centre.
Reviews planned cost against budget and adjusts or comments.
Submits the consolidated plan for approval.
Approves the plan, or approves with adjustments.
Writes approved additions as new sanctioned-strength versions effective from their planned dates.
Tracks monthly variance of actual filled and open counts against the plan.

alternate_flows.condition: A position is proposed as a replacement.
steps: The proposal names the vacated position code and consumes no new sanctioned strength.
Comments are attached and the plan returns to HR in draft.

exception_flows.condition: A requisition would exceed approved sanctioned strength.
exception_flows.handling: The requisition is blocked at approval and the variance is shown.

exception_flows.condition: No cost rate exists for a designation band.
exception_flows.handling: The line is flagged as unpriced and the plan cannot be submitted until a rate is set.

nfrs: A plan for 5 sites and 200 org-unit and designation lines recalculates in under 3 s after each edit.
Variance figures are derived on read and never stored as editable values.

user_stories.want: a plan seeded with today's sanctioned, filled and open counts
user_stories.so_that: I start from facts, not a blank sheet

acceptance.given: Chakan Works Machining has 20 sanctioned, 17 filled and 1 open requisition
acceptance.then: the line shows headroom of 2

acceptance.given: a manager proposes +6 machinists from Q2
acceptance.then: planned Q2 headcount is 26 and planned cost updates

user_stories.want: planned cost by cost centre before approval
user_stories.so_that: headcount growth fits the operating budget

acceptance.given: a plan adding 6 band-B positions at Chakan
acceptance.then: the incremental annual cost per cost centre is shown

acceptance.given: a designation band with no cost rate
acceptance.then: submission is blocked with the unpriced line named

user_stories.want: monthly variance of actual headcount against the approved plan
user_stories.so_that: I can act early on over- or under-hiring

acceptance.given: the approved plan for Peenya Assembly in October 2026 is 30
acceptance.when: 29 are filled and 2 requisitions are open
acceptance.then: the variance view shows +1 against plan

acceptance.given: a requisition that would exceed sanctioned strength
acceptance.then: it is blocked and the excess is stated

use_cases.name: Present a digital ID and download verifiable employment letters
use_cases.goal: Give employees a digital ID card and on-demand employment and salary certificates that third parties can verify.

stakeholders.interest: Gets a certificate for a bank loan or visa without waiting for HR.
Fewer manual letter requests and no forged letters in circulation.
Gate staff can check a digital ID quickly.

use_cases.trigger: An employee opens the digital ID or requests an employment or salary certificate.
preconditions: The employee has an active assignment and a verified photograph on record.
Certificate templates and signing keys are configured per legal entity.
postconditions_success: The employee holds a signed certificate with a verification code; any verifier can confirm authenticity without seeing more than the certificate states.
postconditions_failure: No certificate is issued and the reason is shown to the employee.

main_flow.action: Opens the digital ID card in the mobile app, showing photo, name, employee code, entity and site.
Requests a salary certificate for the last 3 months for a bank loan application.
Reads assignment and posted payroll results for the period from the record.
Generates the certificate from the entity template, signs it with the entity key and adds a verification code.
Downloads the certificate or shares its verification link with the bank.
On verification, confirms authenticity, issue date and certificate contents only.
Logs issue and every verification against the employee's record.

alternate_flows.condition: The certificate needs custom wording, such as a visa-purpose letter.
steps: The request routes to HR operations, who approve the wording before generation.
Verification confirms the certificate was valid on issue and states the separation date.

exception_flows.condition: A requested month has no posted payroll result.
exception_flows.handling: That month is excluded and the employee is told which months are included.

exception_flows.condition: The assignment is suspended or ended.
exception_flows.handling: The digital ID is shown as inactive and cannot be presented as valid.

nfrs: A certificate is generated in under 10 s.
Verification works without the verifier holding an account and reveals nothing beyond the certificate.

user_stories.want: to download a salary certificate myself
user_stories.so_that: I can apply for a loan the same day

acceptance.given: I am E1044 with posted payroll for July to September 2026
acceptance.then: a signed PDF with a verification code is ready within 10 s

acceptance.given: September payroll is not yet posted
acceptance.then: the certificate covers July and August and says so

user_stories.want: certificates to be verifiable by third parties
user_stories.so_that: forged letters cannot pass as ours

acceptance.given: a bank enters the verification code of a genuine certificate
acceptance.then: it confirms LE-01 issued it on the stated date with the stated contents

acceptance.given: a tampered certificate with an altered amount
acceptance.then: verification reports a mismatch

user_stories.want: a digital ID on my phone
user_stories.so_that: I can identify myself at another Vindhya site without a plastic card

acceptance.given: I am an active employee at Chakan Works
acceptance.then: it shows my photo, code, entity LE-01 and a code that refreshes every 60 s

acceptance.given: my assignment ended on 2026-09-30
acceptance.when: I open the digital ID on 2026-10-01
acceptance.then: it is marked inactive

use_cases.name: Monitor organisation health metrics by unit
use_cases.goal: Show managers and HR span of control, layers, vacancy age, tenure mix and flight-risk concentration per organisation unit.

stakeholders.interest: Can spot structural problems such as very wide spans or long-open vacancies early.
Flight-risk signals are never shown for identifiable individuals below the aggregation threshold.
Can compare site organisation health on consistent definitions.

use_cases.trigger: A manager or HR user opens the organisation health view for a unit.
preconditions: Assignments, positions and the reporting hierarchy are current.
Metric definitions and the minimum group size for risk aggregation are configured.
postconditions_success: The user sees metrics for units within their scope, with definitions, trend and drill-down limited to their grants.
postconditions_failure: Metrics for units outside scope or below the group-size threshold are suppressed with a stated reason.

main_flow.action: Opens organisation health for their unit, for example Peenya Works Assembly.
Resolves the reporting subtree within the user's scope at query time.
Derives span of control, layers, vacancy age, tenure mix and headcount from positions and assignments.
Computes flight-risk concentration per unit from approved signals and returns only aggregated bands.
Displays each metric with its definition, 12-month trend and a threshold indicator.
Drills into a long-open vacancy or a manager with a wide span.
Compares the same metrics across all five sites and records an action, such as splitting a team.

steps: The export contains aggregated metrics only and is logged.

exception_flows.condition: A unit has fewer people than the minimum group size.
exception_flows.handling: Flight-risk concentration is suppressed for that unit and marked as below threshold.

exception_flows.condition: The user requests a unit outside their reporting line.
exception_flows.handling: The unit is not returned and the view states it is outside scope.

nfrs: Metrics for a 1,000-person subtree load in under 3 s.
No flight-risk value is shown for any group smaller than the configured minimum size.

user_stories.want: span, layers and vacancy age for my unit
user_stories.so_that: I can see where my structure needs attention

acceptance.given: I am E1021 managing Peenya Assembly with 9 direct reports and one position vacant since 2026-07-15
acceptance.then: I see span 9, vacancy age 113 days and my layer count

acceptance.given: I request Chakan Works Machining
acceptance.then: the unit is refused as outside my reporting line

user_stories.want: the same metrics compared across all five sites
user_stories.so_that: I can prioritise interventions where structure is weakest

acceptance.given: my grant covers LE-01 and LE-02
acceptance.then: five sites are listed with span, layers, vacancy age and tenure mix

acceptance.given: a manager at Oragadam Works with span 22 and the threshold set at 15
acceptance.then: that manager's unit is flagged above threshold

user_stories.want: my individual flight-risk score never to be shown to managers
user_stories.so_that: I am not singled out on an inference

acceptance.given: a unit of 4 people and a minimum group size of 5
acceptance.then: flight-risk concentration is suppressed for that unit

acceptance.given: a unit of 30 people
acceptance.then: it appears only as a band for the unit with no individual names
